services.desc: During your trip: remember that with some 3000 miles of shoreline, 2500 square miles of water, and over 70 islands you have a chance to see some of Alaska’s most beautiful shore lines and animals that live there. Be prepared to find Ball’s Porpoise, Harbor Seals, Stellar Sea Lions, Killer Whales and Humpback Whales, the always present Sea Otter and sea birds. You will also see land animals, from Black Bears to Sitka deer! If you are really lucky, you might even see a Brown bear on Montague Island. "Are we there yet?"
